description: Water Supply - Daily Rainfall (at the 4 Major Harvesting Storage Dams) is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Melbourne Water Corporation. Daily point rainfall values. This data is collected with rainfall telemetry devices installed at the catchment storage dams, and verified with field observations daily. This data provides daily rainfall observed for the 24hr period from 8am to 8am. This data provides our customers and community with the daily observed rainfall information. Coverage: Victoria. The portal files it under the publisher Melbourne Water Corporation. Its tags are Open Data, catchments, rain, rainfall, storage dams. It offers 11 resource(s) in arcgis geoservices rest api, csv, gdb, geojson, gpkg. The portal shows 2025-02-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
